params.1273: Get a bronze pickaxe so that you can make metal armour and weapons.
params.1274: Talk to <col=FFFFFF>Tobias Bronzearms</col>. Tell him you need <col=FFFFFF>mining supplies</col>.
params.1275: <col=FFFFFF>Right-click</col> the <col=FFFFFF>bronze pickaxe</col> in the 'free sample items' category and select 'take 1' to get your free bronze pickaxe.
params.1276: When you're done, <col=FFFFFF>close</col> the shop window.
